decision_encoding.array_rule: Each checks array is positionally aligned with its corresponding check_order array and contains an explicit PASS or FAIL for every item.
decision_encoding.concept_status_rule: FAIL if any document check or concept-batch check for that concept is FAIL.
decision_encoding.pair_status_rule: FAIL if the reciprocal-pair style check fails or either constituent concept has overall status FAIL.
decision_encoding.overall_status_rule: Every document, concept-batch, and pair-level check must pass; any failure makes the review FAIL.
